description: Defines enums, macros, and constants related to dispatch keys and backends in PyTorch, including BackendComponent and DispatchKey enums, and functions for dispatch key manipulation.

classes.name: BackendComponent
classes.description: Enum class representing different backends for dispatch, such as CPU, CUDA, HIP, etc.

classes.name: DispatchKey
classes.description: Enum class representing various dispatch keys used for function dispatching, including functionality keys, backend-specific keys, alias keys, and special keys.

methods.name: isAliasDispatchKey
methods.description: Checks if a given DispatchKey is an alias mapping to other runtime keys.

methods.name: isPerBackendFunctionalityKey
methods.description: Checks if a given DispatchKey is a per-backend functionality key.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a DispatchKey or BackendComponent to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a DispatchKey or BackendComponent to an output stream.

methods.name: getAutogradKeyFromBackend
methods.description: Returns the autograd DispatchKey associated with a given BackendComponent.

methods.name: parseDispatchKey
methods.description: Parses a string to produce a corresponding DispatchKey, throws if invalid.

methods.name: toBackendComponent
methods.description: Converts a DispatchKey or DeviceType to its corresponding BackendComponent.

methods.name: toFunctionalityKey
methods.description: Converts a DispatchKey to its corresponding functionality key.

methods.name: toRuntimePerBackendFunctionalityKey
methods.description: Given a functionality DispatchKey and a BackendComponent, returns the combined runtime DispatchKey.
